A copy defect was observed and deliberately NOT fixed in this revision: the Library empty-state hint reads `Use Create in the navigation to import a product photo.…` while the navigation control has been named `+ Photo` since the shell rewrite. Editing app source would lapse the recorded release approval and invalidate the uploaded bundle, so the fix is scheduled for the next revision (`0.1.2`) rather than slipped into the approved one.

Not driven on this revision, and therefore not claimed: a photo import through the `+ Photo` / `Add a photo` path, background and cutout generation (a paid provider call), the marketplace export pack, the library grid with saved projects, and an actual Google Play purchase. The preceding record was written against a different build digest, so nothing from it is carried over as evidence about this one.
